title: XXXIII Guernica Installation
description: Large-scale wall-mounted collage dominated by concentric target rings, compact discs, and warplane silhouettes distributed across a dense, multi-panel composition. Visible inscription 'XXXIIIa' appears at lower center; elements include an american football, reel-to-reel imagery, and layered photographic fragments on white ground.
composition: dense all-over horizontal panoramic multi-panel spread
